scope: The biotin-labeled proteins were then enriched with streptavidin-coated beads and analyzed using mass spectrometry.
The supernatant was collected after centrifugation at 12,000 g for 15 min at 4°C and incubated overnight with 100 μL streptavidin-coated magnetic beads with rotation at 4°C.

The biotinylated proteins were eluted by boiling the beads with sodium dodecyl sulfate (SDS) loading buffer at 100°C for 10 min. The eluted proteins were analyzed by Western blotting or mass spectrometry (MS).
